title: Statement on the President’s Decision Regarding the U.S. Business of Aixtron SE | U.S. Department of the Treasury
主要内容: On December 2, 2016, the U.S. Department of the Treasury issued a statement regarding the President’s decision to prohibit the acquisition of Aixtron SE’s U.S. business by Grand Chip Investment GmbH and its shareholders. The order requires the Purchasers and Aixtron to abandon the proposed acquisition within 30 days. Aixtron, Inc., a subsidiary of Aixtron SE, was part of the proposed acquisition. The President acted under Section 721 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended by the Foreign Investment and National Security Act of 2007, to suspend the transaction due to national security concerns. CFIUS concluded that the transaction posed an unresolved risk to U.S. national security. The proposed acquisition was to be funded in part by Sino IC Leasing Co., Ltd., a financing provider associated with the China IC Industry Investment Fund.
